title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode4 An Unexpected Customer

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Let's cut there for now!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We'll do the close-up of the parfait now, so let's get a light on it! Oh, let's get a napkin with the cafe's logo to go with that shot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like the crew's working constantly during these shoots even when we're on break...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, only the personalities get to rest. I honestly can't thank them enough for all their hard work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Short segments like this one will only end up being a few minutes long, but it takes an entire day to film it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it's our job to make this show as fun as possible. So, let's do our best and make the most of what the crew is doing for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!
I'm so glad we were able to make a reservation!
You heard about how this cafe's doing a shoot today because it's been going so viral on social media, right?

Yeah.
And the staff was so polite about us visiting. I hope we don't startle everyone else here too much.

I mean, we are a pretty rowdy bunch.
I sorta think they have every right to feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The cafe's become much livelier all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's the group the manager was talking about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should be fine because we have these curtains up, but we still need to be on our best behavior.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty rare for groups to make reservations for here. I wonder what they're...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!
That group of customers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's wrong, Minori? Wait, huh?

I can't wait.
I'm starved.

Order as much as you like.
We warned this cafe beforehand that we'd be coming.

Awesome!
And it's like they came up with these Mount Everest sized menu items just for us! Thanks, Fujin! You always find the best places!

Hehe. Anytime.
I mean, what's better than stuffing our faces in sweets after doing an event?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-Hey, isn't that the female professional wrestler, Riser☆Fujin?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is she famous...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She's really popular on PicShare!
She has like 1.5 million followers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lately, everyone's been talking about how she's been helping wrestling teams and organizations who've fallen on hard times get back on their feet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea she was so popular...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and she's famous for being a huge sweets connoisseur. She's even come up with some for a few convenience stores...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But she's most famous for taking other wrestlers from her organization out after big matches to tackle mountains of sweets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mountains of...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: Okay, let's order...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
To start, we'd like ten of your Mount Everest strawberry parfaits and eight of your seasonal waffles!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: U-Uhh, wow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is turning into a pretty big test for the staff...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Okay, break's over!
Let's resume our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-We have to get back to work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope Mizuki and Saki are going to be okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't do much to help right now, so we'll just have to believe that they will be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've got this, you two...!
Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kitchen Staff Member
rows.Line: I've got two plates of waffles ready here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've got three!
Mizuki, how are you doing on your end...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
G-Gimme a sec...!
I'm still not done with the first three I got!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait... Five dollops of whipped cream, right...? Two, three, four, five.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, done!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Not bad if I do say so myself!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll start working on the ones we just got!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
I'm just about done making my batch, so I'll help you with the whipped cream and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
D-Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The cream on the edge of this plate sort of fell apart...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, it's a little lower than the other ones... But is it gonna be that big of a problem?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, the bow in the middle of this one looks better than any of the other ones...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope, do it again!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whaat?!
But I thought it turned out really well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, I know it's really hard to get everything to look all nice and pretty when things are super busy. Which makes cutting corners all the more tempting...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Each plate may be one out of the many for us, but each one means everything to our customers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we have to give each plate the love it deserves regardless of how busy things get...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's the motto of carino/carina!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Give each plate... The love it deserves...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I also obsess over the tiniest stuff whenever I'm making something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you understand.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The first time our boss told me that, I also thought it was a really strict rule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I began to understand the reasoning behind it after seeing the smiles on all our customers' faces.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you're making something for someone, you should do everything you can for it. Otherwise, the person receiving it won't understand what you were trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll start over!
I'm gonna make it look gorgeous this time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what I like to hear♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll show you how to gussy up the whipped cream. For the ones that fell apart slightly, just do this and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's so cool!
They look perfect now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
You just have to do this now if something goes wrong.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's try to get those orders out and...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me!
We'd like five more plates of your mega pudding a la mode!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Mizuki
rows.Line: Eeeeeepp!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Was that a scream I just heard...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I really hope Mizuki and Saki are okay...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I wish we could lend them a hand...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
A-Anyway...
Including our parfaits, we've put quite a lot of thought into each of our menu items. As a result, our customers have been giving us some very nice reviews.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right...!
Now's our chance to...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree! The parfaits are one thing, but the rest of the menu also looks amazing! I've even been hearing some of the other customers ordering some of these items...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which gave me an idea...
